title: Organizers of Hong Kong Vigils for Tiananmen Massacre Sentenced to Prison
summary_full: Chow Hang-tung, Lee Cheuk-yan and Albert Ho were given lengthy prison sentences under a national security law imposed on the city by Beijing.
summary_public: Chow Hang-tung, Lee Cheuk-yan and Albert Ho were given lengthy prison sentences under a national security law imposed on the city by Beijing.
